# Security, Offline/Sync & Credit-Card Rules Checklist: Controle Financeiro Familiar Offline-First

**Purpose**: Validar a qualidade (completude, clareza, consistência, mensurabilidade e cobertura) dos requisitos de segurança, offline/sincronização e regras de cartão de crédito antes da implementação.
**Created**: 2026-10-01
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [data-model.md](../data-model.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Segurança (Auth, RBAC, Isolamento, Auditoria)

- [x] CHK001 Are authentication requirements specified for every protected resource and action? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001–FR-015]
- [x] CHK002 Is step-up 2FA triggered by an exhaustive, closed list of sensitive actions with "ação sensível" defined unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003/FR-015]
- [x] CHK003 Are Magic Link token properties quantified (origem aleatória, expiração, invalidação após uso único)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-002/FR-007]
- [x] CHK004 Are trusted-device and recovery-code lifecycles fully specified (duração, revogação, uso único, exibição única)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004/FR-005]
- [x] CHK005 Are household isolation requirements stated for 100% of reads and writes, explicitamente incluindo rotas de sync? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009/FR-041]
- [x] CHK006 Is the role-permission matrix complete and non-overlapping across all five roles? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK007 Is the member limit expressed as an enforceable backend rule with exact counts and a stated rationale? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [x] CHK008 Are audit requirements defined for what is captured and what is explicitly excluded (segredos/PII)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-055, NFR-002]
- [x] CHK009 Are secret-handling requirements defined for tokens/2FA secrets in transit, at rest and in logs? [Coverage, Spec §NFR-002]
- [x] CHK010 Are rate-limit thresholds defined per route with window and response behavior (`429` + `Retry-After`)? [Measurability, Spec §FR-056]
- [x] CHK011 Is the offline interaction specified for every step-up action (bloqueada vs enfileirada) without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK012 Are ownership/least-privilege boundaries explicit between `owner` and `partner`? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/FR-015]
- [x] CHK013 Are security failure/breach response requirements defined (lockout, revogação, notificação)? [Gap, Exception Flow]
- [x] CHK014 Is the threat model / trust boundary documented and traceable to requirements? [Traceability, Gap]

## Offline / Sincronização

- [x] CHK015 Is idempotency keyed and scoped exactly (campos, unicidade) with retry semantics defined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-040]
- [x] CHK016 Is the conflict-resolution policy specified for every pair (update/update, create/delete, delete/update)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-042/FR-043, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK017 Is LWW tie-breaking unambiguous for equal timestamps and clock skew between client and server? [Clarity, Spec §FR-042]
- [x] CHK018 Is the sync cursor/delta contract specified (monotonicidade, inclusão de soft deletes, paginação)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-041]
- [x] CHK019 Are Outbox ordering, retry/backoff and terminal failure states specified? [Clarity, Spec §FR-038]
- [x] CHK020 Are requirements defined for orphaned updates and their user-visible notification? [Coverage, Spec §FR-043]
- [x] CHK021 Is optimistic-UI behavior and post-sync reconciliation quantified instead of "instantâneo/sem bloquear"? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-006]
- [x] CHK022 Are offline write scopes enumerated (quais entidades/ações funcionam offline vs bloqueadas)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-036/FR-015]
- [x] CHK023 Are multi-device convergence requirements stated and testable? [Completeness, Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK024 Is conflict visibility/notification to the user defined and objectively verifiable? [Gap, Measurability]
- [x] CHK025 Are sync-failure observability requirements quantified (contadores, último erro, tentativas)? [Measurability, Spec §NFR-009/FR-044]
- [x] CHK026 Are soft-delete requirements consistent across client deletion, server tombstone and pull? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022/FR-041]

## Regras de Cartão de Crédito

- [x] CHK027 Is the invoice cutoff rule defined for the exact closing day (inclusive/exclusive) without ambiguity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031/FR-035]
- [x] CHK028 Are installment allocation rules specified (uma parcela por ciclo, tratamento do resto de arredondamento) and testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-035]
- [x] CHK029 Is behavior defined when `closing_day`/`due_day` exceeds the month length (clamp) and for leap years? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [x] CHK030 Are invoice state transitions specified with their triggers and timing? [Completeness, Spec §FR-033]
- [x] CHK031 Are "valor parcial/total" and "valor pago" of an invoice defined unambiguously? [Clarity, Spec §FR-034]
- [x] CHK032 Are requirements defined for editing/deleting a transaction already assigned to an invoice? [Coverage, Gap]
- [x] CHK033 Are card–account relationship constraints (1–1, tipo `cartao_credito`) and limit/currency rules specified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030, data-model]
- [x] CHK034 Are `purchase_at_posting` and `uses_account_balance_for_invoice` specified with observable user-visible effects? [Ambiguity, data-model]
- [x] CHK035 Are dashboard invoice-block requirements consistent with invoice status definitions? [Consistency, Spec §FR-046/FR-033]
- [x] CHK036 Is the interaction between card purchases and receita/despesa totals defined to prevent double counting? [Consistency, Gap, Spec §FR-024]

## Rastreabilidade & Cobertura Transversal

- [x] CHK037 Do all FR/NFR map to at least one acceptance scenario or success criterion? [Traceability]
- [x] CHK038 Are security/sync/card success criteria measurable and free of implementation detail? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002/SC-004/SC-007]
- [x] CHK039 Are the assumptions about server-as-source-of-truth and conflict policy validated against the edge cases? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
- **Revisão assistida 2026-10-01**: 39/39 aprovados. CHK021 resolvido (NFR-006 agora ≤100 ms p95); CHK037 resolvido (FR-057/FR-058/FR-059 com cenários de aceite em US1/US5/US8).
